fields.label: Profile Name
fields.description: A label for this bundle of access, for example 'Sales Agent' or 'Read-only Reporting'.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: A disabled profile grants nothing, without deleting it.

fields.label: Full Access
fields.description: Grants every action on every DocType, ignoring the grid below. The user's own Frappe permissions and the site backstop still apply. Assign only to a user whose Frappe permissions are already the limit you want.

fields.label: Allow SQL
fields.description: Lets the raw read-only SQL tool be used. That tool ignores DocType permissions entirely, grant only to users who already have full database access. Also needs the SQL switch in Synapse Settings.

fields.options: A user's reach through Synapse is the union of every enabled profile whose roles they hold. Ticks here are a ceiling, not a grant, the user still needs the matching Frappe permission on each record.

fields.label: Roles
fields.description: A user holding any of these roles is covered by this profile.

fields.options: Each row lists a DocType and what may be done to it. Nothing is reachable unless it appears here (or Full Access is ticked). Every action beyond Read also needs 'Enable Write Tools' in Synapse Settings.

Tools contributed by other installed apps. List each by its exact name to let this profile's roles call it. This is separate from DocType access, and Full Access does not include it, because a custom tool can run any code its app wrote. The site also needs 'Enable Custom Tools' in Synapse Settings.
